name: Company MCP Server - Google Workspace Integration
description: Enables Claude to interact with Google Workspace services including Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Docs, and Calendar. Provides comprehensive tools for reading, creating, and managing emails, files, spreadsheets, documents, and calendar events with built-in safety controls and audit logging.

Provides comprehensive tools for reading, creating, and managing emails, files, spreadsheets, documents, and calendar events with built-in safety controls and audit logging.

OAUTH_TOKEN_PATH.description: Path to the OAuth token JSON file

DRIVE_MODIFY_ENABLED.description: Enable Drive modification operations (create folder, set permission, copy, upload, move)

CALENDAR_MODIFY_ENABLED.description: Enable Calendar modification operations (create, update, delete events)

DRIVE_ALLOWLIST_FOLDERS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed folder IDs for Drive operations (required for Service Account mode)

CALENDAR_DRY_RUN_DEFAULT.description: Default dry-run mode for Calendar create/update operations
